      <div data-fluid-engine="true"><style></style><div class="fluid-engine fe-68553727b58fc2086c5e483b"><div class="fe-block fe-block-yui_3_17_2_1_1750414832008_2301"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1750414832008_2301" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1750414832008_2301"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Sunrise Cabana</h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong><em>Spacious • Breezy • Steps From the Sea</em></strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Wake up to the first light over Roatán’s quiet East End. The Sunrise Cabana is our most spacious accommodation — an upper-level, two-bedroom retreat set directly on the beach, with sweeping views of the Caribbean Sea and the green hills behind it. Here, mornings are peaceful, the breeze is steady, and the sound of the waves sets the rhythm for each day.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The master bedroom features a queen bed and screened French doors that open onto your private balcony, allowing you to fall asleep and wake up to the sound of the sea. The second bedroom also offers a queen bed and a beautiful mountain view, making it a calming retreat of its own.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The living space opens onto a private oceanfront balcony — perfect for slow breakfasts, reading in the hammock, or relaxing in Honduran-crafted Adirondack chairs while enjoying the breeze and shifting colors of the water.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">A fully equipped kitchenette (full-size fridge, stove, oven, microwave, coffee maker, and panini press) gives you the flexibility to prepare simple meals at your own pace.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Designed with natural airflow in mind, the cabana features louvered windows and doors that invite the cooling trade winds throughout the day. For added comfort, the Sunrise Cabana also includes air conditioning.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Ideal for families, friends traveling together, or longer stays, the Sunrise Cabana offers space, comfort, and a front-row seat to the peaceful beauty of Camp Bay. This is East End living at its most relaxed and effortless.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Accommodates:</strong> up to 4 adults&nbsp;</p></div>
